metrics.profile_summary: Procurement and branding professional with an MBA in Marketing. Experienced in vendor management, cost optimization, and physical brand implementation within the banking sector.

experience.description: Manages vendor partnerships, product standardization, and cost-saving initiatives. Leads procurement team and oversees branding dashboards and marketing material production.
Ensured adherence to marketing guidelines for physical branding and signage. Managed vendors and project timelines for branch renovations and relocations.
Handled procurement of technical equipment and negotiated deals to achieve significant cost savings (PKR 156M+). Managed RFP processes and audit controls.
Managed maintenance of power systems and CCTV, handled administrative tasks, and oversaw vendor performance reviews and audit reporting.

strengths: Strong vendor and people management experience
Experience in physical brand execution and guidelines
weaknesses: No experience with digital marketing, GA4, or ad platforms
Lacks experience in integrated consumer brand campaigns
Background is primarily in procurement and facilities rather than marketing strategy
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a procurement specialist with a marketing degree. While he has managed physical branding and teams, he lacks the essential digital marketing skills (GA4, ad reporting) and strategic growth experience required for a Marketing Manager role.
